1.consolidated_definition: También se documenta el tratamiento ocasional de pariente entre compadres. “No jinche, pariente.” Meléndez Muñoz.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Also documented is the occasional treatment of kinship between compadres. "No jinche, pariente." Meléndez Muñoz.

Traducción:

It also documents the occasional treatment of kinship between godfathers. No get involved, relative.
